title: Don't be so sure! 别那么肯定！
description: A dialogue lesson in which Martin asks Gary where he is going to spend his holidays and Gary explains that he can't make up his mind — his wife always worries too much, and in the end they stay at home and look after everything. The story introduces the modal verbs for possibility: 'may be/do' (present or future possibility), 'may have been/done' (past possibility), and 'might' (a less certain possibility than may). The workbook drills comprehension of the dialogue by completing it with the missing words and matching verbs with their partners; the grammar workbook completes blanks with 'may be/do' or 'may have been/done', answers questions with 'may' according to an example, and answers questions with 'may have …' according to an example.
answer_note: The dialogue is the lesson text. Practice A (complete the dialogue with the missing words) and Practice B (which verbs go with which words, then fill in the blanks) are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-129-135.jpg p.216). Grammar I (fill in with may be/do or may have been/done), II (answer the questions using may) and III (answer the questions using may have …) are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.567).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question. What's the problem about deciding on a holiday? 听录音，然后回答问题。决定如何度假有什么为难的地方？
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。决定如何度假有什么为难的地方？

lines.speaker: MARTIN
lines.text: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary?
lines.translation: 加里，今年你们打算去哪里度假？

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: We may go abroad. I'm not sure.
lines.translation: 我们可能到国外去，但我不敢肯定。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: My wife wants to go to Egypt.

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: I'd like to go there, too.

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: We can't make up our minds.

lines.speaker: MARTIN
lines.text: Will you travel by sea or by air?
lines.translation: 你们乘船去，还是乘飞机去？

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time.
lines.translation: 可能是便宜些，但花的时间长。

lines.speaker: MARTIN
lines.translation: 我肯定你们一定会玩得很痛快。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.translation: 我们可能哪里也去不成。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: My wife always worries too much.
lines.translation: 我妻子总是担心这担心那的。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: Who's going to look after the dog?

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: Who's going to look after the house?

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: Who's going to look after the garden?

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: We have this problem every year.
lines.translation: 我们每年都碰到这类问题。

lines.speaker: GARY
lines.text: In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!
lines.translation: 末了，我们呆在家里来照看一切。

items.title: 1. We may go abroad.
items.text: 在英文中用 may 来表示可能发生的事，在 may 后面加动词原形。请注意 may 表示的是一种可能性，这与第 127 课所讲的表示有根据的推论是有区别的。

items.title: 3. Don't be so sure.
items.text: 别那么肯定。在祈使句中，be 动词的否定形式要用 don't be，这种结构常常用于劝告。

items.title: 4. We might not go anywhere.
items.text: 我们可能哪里也去不成。might 可以用来表示一种可能性，但它表示的「肯定」程度还不如 may。和 may 一样，might 所表示的是现在或将来的可能性。

practice.title: Practice A: Complete the dialogue
practice.instruction: Read this dialogue. Fill in the missing words. 阅读下面的对话，把缺少的词语填进去。
practice.translation: 阅读下面的对话，把缺少的词语填进去。
practice.context: One dialogue-completion item: the dialogue from the textbook with the key words removed. Write the complete dialogue with all missing words filled in.

questions.prompt: Martin: Where are you ___ to ___ your ___ this year, Gary? — Gary: We may go ___. I'm not ___. My ___ wants to ___ to ___. I'd ___ to go ___, too. We can't ___ up our ___. — Martin: Will you ___ by ___ or ___ air? — Gary: We ___ travel ___ sea. It ___ be cheaper, but it ___ a long ___. — Martin: I'm sure you'll ___ yourselves. — Gary: Don't be ___ sure! We ___ not go ___! My wife always ___ too much. Who's ___ to look ___ the dog, the house and the garden? In the ___, we ___ at home and ___ after ___!
questions.answer: Martin: Where are you going to spend your holidays this year, Gary? Gary: We may go abroad. I'm not sure. My wife wants to go to Egypt. I'd like to go there, too. We can't make up our minds. Martin: Will you travel by sea or by air? Gary: We may travel by sea. It may be cheaper, but it takes a long time. Martin: I'm sure you'll enjoy yourselves. Gary: Don't be so sure! We might not go anywhere! My wife always worries too much. Who's going to look after the dog, the house and the garden? In the end, we stay at home and look after everything!

practice.title: Practice B: Vocabulary
practice.instruction: Which verbs in the box on the left go with the words in the box on the right? They all come from the dialogue. Now fill in the blanks in these sentences. 为左框中的动词选出恰当的搭配方式，然后把这些句子中的空缺处填上。
practice.translation: 为左框中的动词选出恰当的搭配方式，然后把这些句子中的空缺处填上。
practice.context: Word bank: spend · go · look after · make up · travel — abroad · by air · your mind · holidays · the dog. 5 fill-in-the-blank items drawn from the dialogue.

questions.prompt: Last year we ___ ___ in Italy.
questions.answer: spent, holidays

questions.prompt: Not many Chinese people ___ ___ for their holidays.
questions.answer: go, abroad

questions.prompt: Please ___ ___. Are you coming with us or not?
questions.answer: make up, your mind

questions.prompt: Can you ___ ___ for us while we are away?
questions.answer: look after, the dog

questions.prompt: My friend never ___ ___ because she is always ill in a plane.
questions.answer: travels, by air

grammar.title: Grammar I: Fill in the blanks with 'may be/do' or 'may have been/done'
grammar.instruction: 用 may be/do 或 may have been/done 填空。
grammar.translation: 用 may be/do 或 may have been/done 填空。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.567 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 fill-in items with the verb in brackets.

questions.prompt: She ___ (come) with us. She hasn't made up her mind.
questions.answer: may come

questions.prompt: I ___ (pass) the exam. I don't know. I haven't heard the results yet.
questions.answer: may have passed

questions.prompt: There ___ (be) good news soon. I'm not sure.
questions.answer: may be

questions.prompt: He thinks that there ___ (be) a change in the programme.
questions.answer: may be

questions.prompt: They were very late. They ___ (miss) the bus.
questions.answer: may have missed

questions.prompt: She didn't come to work yesterday. She ___ (be) ill.
questions.answer: may have been

questions.prompt: He didn't finish it. He ___ (have) too little time to do it. I'm not sure.
questions.answer: may have had

questions.prompt: We haven't made up our minds. We ___ (travel) to Hainan this winter.
questions.answer: may travel

questions.prompt: He ___ (find) his lost key. I'm not sure.
questions.answer: may have found

questions.prompt: She doesn't look Japanese. She ___ (be) Korean.
questions.answer: may be

grammar.title: Grammar II: Answer the questions using 'may'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 may 回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 may 回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.567 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 answer items; item 1 (Will he get his licence? → He may get it or he may not. I'm not sure.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Will he get his licence?
questions.answer: He may get it or he may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Will it rain tomorrow?
questions.answer: It may rain tomorrow or it may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Is she busy?
questions.answer: She may be busy or she may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Will there be a meeting next week?
questions.answer: There may be a meeting next week or there may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Will she go to university this year?
questions.answer: She may go to university this year or she may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Will it be fine tomorrow?
questions.answer: It may be fine tomorrow or it may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Are they having their lunch now?
questions.answer: They may be having their lunch now or they may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Is he in the office?
questions.answer: He may be in the office or he may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Are we going by train?
questions.answer: We may be going by train or we may not. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Will there be a holiday on Friday?
questions.answer: There may be a holiday on Friday or there may not. I'm not sure.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Answer the questions using 'may have …'
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 may have … 回答下列问题。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 may have … 回答下列问题。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.567 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 answer items; item 1 (Did the driver of the car see you? → He may have seen me. I'm not sure.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Did the driver of the car see you?
questions.answer: He may have seen me. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Did the man really see a famous actress?
questions.answer: He may have seen a famous actress. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Was he reading in the library?
questions.answer: He may have been reading in the library. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Was she a policewoman three years ago?
questions.answer: She may have been a policewoman three years ago. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Did he borrow the money from his father?
questions.answer: He may have borrowed the money from his father. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Did it rain this time last year?
questions.answer: It may have rained this time last year. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Was he ill?
questions.answer: He may have been ill. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Did they find the lost case?
questions.answer: They may have found the lost case. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Did Gary stay at home?
questions.answer: Gary may have stayed at home. I'm not sure.

questions.prompt: Did he buy the car?
questions.answer: He may have bought the car. I'm not sure.
